`checkJs` is deliberately FALSE. With it on, every one of the 79 source
files is checked at once and the run opens with hundreds of errors — which
is how a type checker gets switched off again. Instead a file opts in with
`// @ts-check` on its first line, so the set of checked files only ever
grows and the check is green from the first commit.
